notes.title: Hot Update
notes.notes:
Hi, Teevy here. After the awesome launch of the Infinite Update, a few minor problems came to light. Turns out you're supposed to test software BEFORE deploying it.


Updated the "Set Wheels" menu to include presets (All, None, Frenzy etc.)
Enabling "Random Items" (in the Extras menu) no longer breaks the game
Achievements are fixed... again ("I'm Infinite" will be unlocked on launch, if you earned it before)
Holding the shoot button no longer auto-pressed the wheel or choice buttons
A crash from one of the taxes were fixed
Some typos were fixed


Along with that, a new achievement was added along with the "Frenzy" mode for Infinite!

Keep winging it. Teevy out.

notes.title: Sour Update
notes.notes:
There is now a flashing lights warning at start
Updated 3 achievements to make them more fun
Popstars now have unique targeting types
Pengu-wings now have a longer cooldown, and frozen squares only stay frozen for a few seconds
Few bosses have been optimized for Xtreme mode
Upgrade buttons are now centered on the screen
Added "tips" to the death screen
Certain roundly effects such as healing now apply directly after selecting them, and periodically during boss battles
"Deeper" now doubles the pierce, instead of increasing by 1
Farts now affect the extra kids

notes.title: Sweet Update
notes.notes:
A few sweet updates to help you get your wings


 You can hold right click to use wings when they are available
 Guns spawned by wings now last 3 rounds
 Shielded squares now give you money for every 2 layers of shield
 Added one normal and one secret achievement
 Updated 3 achievements
 Increased Pengu-Wings cooldown
 The "Unvaxxed Kids" upgrade now works on all smallest squares
 Mines now destroy all shield layers
 Eye Surgery laser now hits immune squares
 Fixed a bug with the Confuse-Wings
 Minimum speed in Freeplay is now 0.5
 "Too Late" now destroy all shield layers
